item.title: Ykman
item.description:
Links

Python dependencies use the shared uv locking workflow. Dependencies are declared in pyproject.toml and locked in uv.lock. Run //tools/ykman:uv_lock.update to update the native lock and review its diff. Build //tools/ykman:uv_lock to generate it without source writes. The sandboxed resolution action requires network access to PyPI.

  • Install: https://docs.yubico.com/software/yubikey/tools/ykman/Install_ykman.html
  • Import certificate: https://docs.yubico.com/software/yubikey/tools/authenticator/auth-guide/smartc-import-certificates.html
